workstreams.name: Core analysis and visualizer workflow
workstreams.basis: Imports, provider execution, stored code units, source navigation, and review workflows exist. Native Mach-O analysis stores exact-address Swift/Objective-C metadata and exposes capped, hash-checked ReIPA pseudocode alternatives for matched functions; broader provider and format coverage remains incomplete.

workstreams.name: Database-grounded project memory and provenance
workstreams.basis: Project-scoped observations, symbols, relationships, drafts, and review records ground AI context. Exact-address ReIPA pseudocode alternatives for matched Swift/Objective-C methods now enter rewrite context only after same-run path and output-hash verification; cross-provider identity and completeness still need broader validation.

workstreams.name: Major-language and format decompilation fluency
workstreams.basis: Several useful Java, .NET, Android, Python, WebAssembly, and native paths exist, and matched arm64 Mach-O methods can now show early ReIPA C-like pseudocode beside Ghidra output; many languages remain navigation-only, early, or represented by generic pseudocode.

workstreams.name: Maintainable editing, review, and export
workstreams.basis: Hash-bound drafts, review receipts, syntax-aware edits for selected languages, and reproducible export exist; language breadth and project-level edits remain limited.

workstreams.name: Fixture-backed validation and fidelity evidence
workstreams.basis: Provider smoke checks and structural validators exist, but broad versioned clean, optimized, stripped, and obfuscated fixture comparisons are still missing.
